title: Snack Attack
intro: [excited] Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! I hope you came HUNGRY, because tonight's episode is a Snack Attack. Churros, Dole Whip, turkey legs... [laughs] it's all on the menu. Let's dig in.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a sunny theme-park snack cart bursting with treats: churros in paper sleeves, a swirled pineapple soft-serve cone, a smoked turkey leg, striped popcorn boxes, pretzels and frozen bananas, castle spires blurred in the background

categories.title: Anyone Can Cook
categories.intro: Our film category is cooking up something SPECIAL. It's Pixar's 2007 masterpiece, Ratatouille. [chuckles] Wash your paws first.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a bustling Parisian restaurant kitchen at night with copper pots, a bubbling pot of vegetable stew, a tiny chef's hat on the counter and Paris rooftops through the window

clues.clue: What kind of animal is Remy, the little chef with big dreams?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a rat. [laughs] Not a mouse. Mickey would like to clarify that he is not involved.

clues.clue: In which city does Remy chase his dream of cooking at Gusteau's?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Paris. And you can visit his rooftop world at Epcot's France pavilion. Ooh la la.

clues.clue: Which talented cook at Gusteau's teaches Linguini the ropes, and how to keep his station clean?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Colette. [chuckles] Keep your station clean or she will absolutely make you regret it.

clues.clue: Which tiny head chef schemes to slap Gusteau's face on frozen foods?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is Chef Skinner. Frozen burritos with Gusteau's name on them. [gasps] The horror.

clues.clue: What is the name of Remy's big, always-hungry brother?
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is... Emile. Django is their dad. Emile would eat literally anything, garbage included.

categories.title: Snackin' in the Parks
categories.intro: These are the snacks people plan ENTIRE vacations around. [laughs] And I mean entire vacations.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a colorful flat-lay of theme-park snacks on a sunny table: pineapple soft-serve swirl, powdered beignets, a turkey leg and custard buns

clues.clue: Which swirly pineapple soft-serve treat is a must at Adventureland, near the Enchanted Tiki Room?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Dole Whip. [laughs] If you skip it, did you even go to Disney?

clues.clue: Which giant smoky meat snack makes everyone eating it look like a medieval king?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a turkey leg. Napkins are optional, dignity is not included.

clues.clue: At Disneyland's New Orleans Square, which powdered sugar pastries, often shaped like Mickey, are a fan favorite?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is beignets. [whispers] Pro tip, do not breathe in while taking a bite. Powdered sugar everywhere.

clues.clue: Kringla Bakeri og Kafe, home of the sweet custard-filled school bread, is in which Epcot pavilion?
clues.reveal: Drumroll, please... the correct answer is Norway. Grab a school bread after Frozen Ever After. Elsa would approve.

clues.clue: In Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge, a podracer engine turns the roasting spit at which eatery famous for the Ronto Wrap?
clues.reveal: [gasps] Oh, this one is TOUGH. The correct answer is... Ronto Roasters. [chuckles] A droid named 8D-J8 runs the spit, which is the most Star Wars job description ever.

categories.title: Snack Zoom
categories.intro: [mischievously] Our first picture category: I'm zooming way, WAY in on a famous park snack. The image slowly zooms out. Buzz in when you know it.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: an extreme macro magnifying glass hovering over sugary cinnamon crystals and popcorn kernels, playful food photography

clues.clue: Zoomed way in. What park snack is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is popcorn. [mischievously] And the collectible popcorn bucket probably cost more than your ticket.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up macro photo, shallow depth of field, theme park daylight, appetizing food photography, no people, no logos, no text: fluffy buttery popcorn spilling from a red and white striped paper box

clues.clue: Zoomed way in. What park snack is this?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is a churro. Ridges, cinnamon, sugar. The perfect walking snack.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up macro photo, shallow depth of field, theme park daylight, appetizing food photography, no people, no logos, no text: a long ridged golden churro rolled in cinnamon sugar, held in a paper sleeve

clues.clue: Zoomed way in. What famous Disney snack is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a Mickey pretzel. [laughs] Three circles, coarse salt, and a side of cheese sauce. Perfection.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up macro photo, shallow depth of field, theme park daylight, appetizing food photography, no people, no logos, no text: a soft baked pretzel shaped like one big circle with two smaller circles on top, glossy brown crust with coarse salt

clues.clue: Zoomed way in. What frozen park treat is this?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Mickey ice cream bar. Vanilla inside, chocolate shell outside, melting down your arm in Florida heat.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up macro photo, shallow depth of field, theme park daylight, appetizing food photography, no people, no logos, no text: a chocolate-coated vanilla ice cream bar on a wooden stick, shaped like one large circle with two smaller circles on top, a bite taken out

clues.clue: Zoomed way in. What classic Disneyland snack is this?
clues.reveal: [whispers] Only the true Disney nerds got this one. The correct answer is... a frozen banana. [laughs] Dipped in chocolate and nuts, it's been a Disneyland classic for decades.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up macro photo, shallow depth of field, theme park daylight, appetizing food photography, no people, no logos, no text: a frozen banana on a stick dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in chopped peanuts

categories.title: Where Am I Eating?
categories.intro: Reservations, please! [excited] It's another PICTURE category. I'll show you a Disney restaurant, and you tell me where it is or what it's themed to.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: an elegant candlelit restaurant table set for dinner with fancy plates and a folded napkin, twilight fireflies glowing outside the window

clues.clue: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Magic Kingdom is themed to which film?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is Beauty and the Beast. Be our guest! And yes, I sang it in my head. You did too.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: an opulent French castle ballroom dining hall with crystal chandeliers, gold trim and a painted starry ceiling, tables set for dinner

clues.clue: Cinderella's Royal Table serves princess meals inside which Magic Kingdom landmark?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cinderella Castle. [chuckles] Eating dinner inside the castle is the closest most of us will ever get to royalty.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a medieval great hall restaurant with heraldic banners, stained glass windows and goblets, seen from high inside a castle tower

clues.clue: At Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater, you eat in a classic car while watching old monster movie clips. Which park is it in?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Disney's Hollywood Studios. [mischievously] Dinner and a drive-in movie, minus the actual driving.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: an indoor 1950s drive-in movie theater at night with dining tables built into vintage convertible cars facing a big screen glowing with a black-and-white flying saucer

clues.clue: Disneyland's Blue Bayou restaurant sits in eternal twilight overlooking which ride?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pirates of the Caribbean. Wave to the boats as they float past your Monte Cristo sandwich.

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a candlelit restaurant on a bayou in eternal twilight, fireflies, a wooden houseboat and lantern-lit boats drifting past on dark water

clues.clue: Topolino's Terrace, a rooftop restaurant with a character breakfast, crowns which Walt Disney World resort?
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] And the correct answer is... Disney's Riviera Resort. [laughs] Topolino is Mickey's name in Italian. Molto bene!

media.prompt: Original illustration, 16:9, vivid colors, theme-park concept-art style, no text, no logos, no characters, no people: a sunny Mediterranean rooftop terrace restaurant overlooking a lagoon and resort gardens, Italian Riviera style with striped umbrellas

categories.title: Toon Food
categories.intro: Club DJ picked this one: famous foods from Disney movies. Try not to get hungry... [sighs] I already failed.

art.prompt: Original digital painting, cinematic 16:9, rich saturated colors, warm magical lighting, storybook theme-park atmosphere, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters, no people's faces: a whimsical storybook banquet: a shiny red apple, a plate of spaghetti and meatballs, a steaming pot of gumbo, and a tray of golden puff pastries

clues.clue: The Evil Queen tricks Snow White into taking a bite of a poisoned what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an apple. Just one bite. Worst snack in Disney history.

clues.clue: Lady and the Tramp share a romantic plate of what at Tony's restaurant?
clues.reveal: And the correct answer is spaghetti and meatballs. [laughs] And one VERY famous accidental noodle kiss.

clues.clue: During Be Our Guest, Lumiere tells Belle to try what mysterious dish, because it's delicious?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the grey stuff. Don't believe me? Ask the dishes. You can even order it at Be Our Guest.

clues.clue: As a little girl, Tiana cooks a big pot of which dish with her daddy and shares it with the neighbors?
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is gumbo. Tiana's daddy taught her that good food brings people together.

clues.clue: In The Emperor's New Groove, Kronk is a surprisingly gifted chef famous for which appetizer?
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is... spinach puffs. [mischievously] Kronk, why do we even have that lever?
